metadata.name: Overhang
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A two-storey techbase hall: an atrium open to the roof with double damage on its dais, a corridor loop round it, a railed balcony above, and the edge — a ledge with no railing outside the balcony, over a lava pit, where the railgun waits. A small arena for 2–8 players.
